verdict.rationale: Pre-built ML templates and images are a fair question for a GPU cloud, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents only cluster and Node Pool provisioning, Terraform, SUNK, Inference API deployments and object storage. Nothing mentions pre-built PyTorch, CUDA, vLLM or ComfyUI templates or images for launching environments. Infrastructure provisioning primitives are not ready-made ML environments and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can launch from pre-built ML templates (PyTorch, CUDA, vLLM, ComfyUI) instead of assembling an environment from scratch
